title: VideoGame Platform · Catalogue Synchronization
description: Manual date-window imports: retained SQL runs and current inventory; process provider diagnostics from OTLP. No scheduled-job assumptions. SQL history is limited by retained-runs policy, not Prometheus retention.

panels.title: Recorded runs · range
panels.description: Exact retained runs whose start is in the selected range; includes running/abandoned, excludes skipped commands.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS runs FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Completed outcomes · range
panels.description: Exact counts in retained SQL history. Empty may mean none in the range or history already pruned.

targets.rawSql: SELECT outcome, count(*) AS runs FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY outcome

panels.title: Games reconciled · range
panels.description: Committed Game reconciliations in retained runs, not distinct Games. Deferred/failed shown separately. No runs means no value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(created_games + updated_games + unchanged_games) AS reconciled FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Current catalogue
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views.

panels.title: Execution history · range and latest run
Manual run durations
panels.description: One point per completed retained run; duration in seconds. The selected window filters run start, not its completion.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS time, duration_seconds AS "Duration (s)" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) AND completed_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY started_at, ordering_key

panels.title: Runs per day / outcome
panels.description: Recorded manual activity; gaps are days without retained runs, not missed scheduled jobs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', started_at) AS time, count(*)::double precision AS value, outcome AS metric FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) GROUP BY 1, outcome ORDER BY 1, outcome

panels.title: Latest recorded run · all time
panels.description: Latest retained recorded run regardless of selected range. Running status and heartbeat diagnose in-flight work; no periodic freshness claim.

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_from::text || ' → ' || window_to::text AS "Window", started_at AS "Started", outcome AS "Outcome", outcome_code AS "Code", duration_seconds AS "Duration", heartbeat_at AS "Heartbeat" FROM catalogue.observability_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC, ordering_key DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Recent runs · selected range
panels.description: At most 20 retained runs; deterministic ordering. Counters become available when a report is completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at AS "Started", window_from::text || ' → ' || window_to::text AS "Window", outcome AS "Outcome", duration_seconds AS "Duration", created_games AS "Created", updated_games AS "Updated", unchanged_games AS "Unchanged", deferred_games AS "Deferred", failed_games AS "Failed" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at) ORDER BY started_at DESC, ordering_key DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Work composition · retained runs in selected range
Game results
panels.description: Exact summed report counters. Deferral is import policy, not a failure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(created_games) AS "created games", sum(updated_games) AS "updated games", sum(unchanged_games) AS "unchanged games", sum(deferred_games) AS "deferred games", sum(failed_games) AS "failed games" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Release reconciliation
panels.description: Exact report totals; inspections and durable reconciliations are different boundaries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(created_releases) AS "created releases", sum(updated_releases) AS "updated releases", sum(unchanged_releases) AS "unchanged releases", sum(deleted_releases) AS "deleted releases" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Inspected provider release dates
panels.description: Inspected provider evidence across retained completed reports; not current Release count.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(inspected_release_dates) AS "inspected release dates" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Current catalogue quality · independent of selected range
Release provider evidence
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views. Persisted provider evidence, not effective date-derived RELEASED/SCHEDULED.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider_status, count(*) AS releases FROM catalogue.observability_release_quality GROUP BY provider_status ORDER BY provider_status

panels.title: Review / verification
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views.

targets.rawSql: SELECT review_status || ' · ' || verification_level AS quality, count(*) AS releases FROM catalogue.observability_release_quality GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Date precision
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_precision, count(*) AS releases FROM catalogue.observability_release_quality GROUP BY date_precision ORDER BY date_precision

panels.title: Release evidence age bands
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views. Age of last changed synchronized evidence. Unchanged records are not timestamp-refreshed; this is not time since last successful provider verification. Bands are descriptive, not alerts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN last_synchronized_at > now() THEN 'future timestamp' WHEN last_synchronized_at >= now() - interval '7 days' THEN '0–7 days' WHEN last_synchronized_at >= now() - interval '30 days' THEN '7–30 days' ELSE '30+ days' END AS evidence_age, count(*) AS releases FROM catalogue.observability_release_quality GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cover sources
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views. Stored approved provider references vs product-owned fallback; neither proves CDN reachability. Rejected references are diagnosed through mapping failures.

panels.title: Oldest evidence timestamps
panels.description: Current database state, independent of the selected time range. SQL is read-only and limited to deliberate module-owned views. Null verification timestamps do not mean verification happened.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(last_synchronized_at) AS oldest_synchronized, max(last_synchronized_at) AS newest_synchronized, min(last_verified_at) AS oldest_verified, count(last_verified_at) AS verified_timestamps FROM catalogue.observability_release_quality

panels.title: Logical calls · observed process
panels.description: Observed process totals; reset on application restart. Missing is not zero. Collector series can survive a restart for up to five minutes. A logical call may include multiple HTTP attempts, authentication and retries.

panels.title: Retries · observed process
panels.description: Observed process totals; reset on application restart. Missing is not zero. Collector series can survive a restart for up to five minutes. Extra provider attempts; rate-limit exhaustion appears as a stable provider failure outcome.

panels.title: Mapping rejections · observed process
panels.description: Observed process totals; reset on application restart. Missing is not zero. Collector series can survive a restart for up to five minutes. Closed mapper reasons; not persistence failures or policy deferrals.

panels.title: Provider mean duration · observed process
panels.description: Observed process totals; reset on application restart. Missing is not zero. Collector series can survive a restart for up to five minutes. Weighted duration sum/count, including auth/retry waits. Useful for sparse calls; not a percentile.

panels.title: Provider p95 during activity
panels.description: Actual histogram percentile in the rate window; no percentile when no provider calls occurred. Includes auth/retry waits.

panels.title: Command outcomes · observed process
panels.description: Observed process totals; reset on application restart. Missing is not zero. Collector series can survive a restart for up to five minutes. Includes skipped commands which are absent from the durable run ledger. Running is read from SQL instead.

panels.title: Provider calls over retained metric history
panels.description: Cumulative samples in Prometheus retention (seven days initially), not a durable event count over this dashboard’s 30-day range. Restarts reset totals.

panels.title: Reported provider work · selected range
panels.description: Durable report totals; attempts include the client boundary, unlike logical-call counters. Latency column is a summed millisecond duration, not p95.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(provider_attempts) AS "provider attempts", sum(provider_retries) AS "provider retries", sum(provider_latency_millis) AS "provider latency millis" FROM catalogue.observability_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(started_at)

panels.title: Enrichment results · observed process
panels.description: Reported per-run record sums since process start for popularity, featured image, logo and detail-metadata evidence. Categories may overlap; these are not independent Games or a pie composition. Missing is not zero.
